moved.sentence: It does not replace short token lifetimes, refresh-token rotation, audience restriction, or PKCE — combine them.

judged.note: That sender-constraining does not replace short lifetimes, refresh rotation, audience restriction or PKCE is kept, with combining them at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Pick **one** mechanism per API surface and apply it consistently; do not mix bearer and constrained acceptance on the same endpoint without an explicit migration plan.

judged.note: One mechanism per API surface applied consistently, and no mixed bearer/constrained acceptance on an endpoint without an explicit migration plan, are kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Present the choice as a deliberate trade-off: DPoP needs no PKI but adds per-request signing; mTLS reuses transport identity but needs certificate provisioning and TLS termination you control.

judged.note: Presenting the choice as a deliberate trade-off, with both the DPoP and mTLS costs and benefits, is kept at SHOULD.
